answer: Lagoon Horizon Banding.** Each agent identity must hold a distinct, publicly logged position on a shared horizon ledger, keyed to a random lagoon-assigned slot. Duplicate registration collides on the slot, so the second claimant pays a jade-tier penalty equal to twice the base slot fee, rising linearly with each collision. An attacker cloning N identities pays O(N²) in collision fees while honest single agents pay O(1).
